entries.name: Generate GUID
entries.description:
Generates a random GUID (Globally Unique Identifier)
This is useful if you need a quick way to reliably generate unique IDs

inputs.name: Format
inputs.description:
Format of the GUID as a single letter:

N - 32 digits:
00000000000000000000000000000000

D - 32 digits separated by hyphens:
00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000

B - 32 digits separated by hyphens, enclosed in braces:
{00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000}

P - 32 digits separated by hyphens, enclosed in parentheses:
(00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000)

X - Four hexadecimal values enclosed in braces, where the fourth value is a subset of eight hexadecimal values that is also enclosed in braces:
{0x00000000,0x0000,0x0000,{0x00,0x00,0x00,0x00,0x00,0x00,0x00,0x00}}

inputs.name: Port
inputs.description: Local TCP port for the MCP server. Use this port when connecting an MCP client to Swiftlet. Default: 3001.

inputs.name: Tools
inputs.description: Tool definitions to expose to the MCP client. Each connected tool creates a matching request output on this component.

inputs.name: Server Name
inputs.description: Server name reported to the MCP client in the MCP connection info.

portNotes.backgroundExpiry: expires/schedules solutions from code (GH2: Expire + Document.Solution.Start / DelayedExpire)

entries.name: MCP Tool Response
entries.description: Sends the result of an MCP tool call back to the client. Return one or more content blocks, optional structured JSON data, and optionally mark the result as an error.

inputs.name: Request
inputs.description: Original request from Deconstruct Tool Call. Each request can be answered only once.

inputs.name: Content Blocks
inputs.description: Content blocks to return to the MCP client, such as text, images, resource links, or embedded resources.

inputs.name: Structured Content
inputs.description: Optional machine-readable JSON result. This can be returned together with content blocks.

inputs.name: Is Error
inputs.description: If true, marks the tool result as an error while still returning the provided content and/or structured data.

outputs.name: Success
outputs.description: True if the response was sent successfully.

entries.name: MCP Tool Response
entries.description: Sends a response back to the MCP client for a tool call.

inputs.name: Request
inputs.description: The tool call request from MCP Server

inputs.name: Is Error
inputs.description: Whether this is an error response

outputs.name: Success
outputs.description: True if the response was sent successfully
